title: 1860 census, Fillmore City, page 101
method: Visually transcribed from preserved original. Column order and row order retained; [blank] denotes an empty cell; ” denotes a ditto mark; [illegible] denotes uncertain text. No surnames or relationships supplied.
notes: Miram on lines 3 and 7 is retained as read, without normalizing to a presumed given name.
Line 15 reads Margt, correcting the earlier tentative Mary A reading.
Lines 22–24 and 34 have been transcribed from the page rather than copied from earlier tentative notes.
The two marks in column 13 are on lines 8 and 23. Color and married-within-year columns are blank throughout.
